raw_text:
{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Build system changes in cmake/secp256k1.cmake and CI workflows follow mechanically from adding new secp256k1 modules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates to build secp256k1 modules do not make this a build system PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates to doc/descriptors.md and doc/psbt.md accompany the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Documentation changes purely document the new CISA descriptors and PSBT fields and follow the code changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp to set consensus deployment parameters.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Modifying chain parameters for a proposed soft fork does not touch the kernel API or library boundary."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/policy/policy.cpp to define mempool standardness rules for witness v2 CISA spends.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds mempool policy standardness rules for CISA transactions alongside the proposed consensus rules. Policy review will be necessary once the consensus proposal stabilizes, but is currently deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches test/functional/mining_basic.py for test adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Does not alter block template construction, fee accounting, or mining interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches test/functional/p2p_segwit.py as a functional test.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Does not change peer-to-peer relay, transport, or network-level message handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to expose PSBT CISA fields and wallet RPCs.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The RPC changes merely expose wallet and PSBT functionality rather than altering the core RPC infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds functional and unit tests in test/functional/test_framework/cisa.py and test/functional/feature_cisa.py.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The test harness additions serve specifically to test CISA consensus and wallet logic rather than test infrastructure itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds extensive cryptographic implementations for BIP458 half-aggregation and BIP459 full-aggregation to src/secp256k1.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds new cryptographic primitive modules `schnorrsig_halfagg` and `fullagg` to the secp256k1 subtree. Reviewing new signature aggregation algorithms and cryptographic verification routines requires deliberate attention for correctness and safety."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP460 consensus validation rules for Taproot key path spends across src/script/interpreter.cpp, src/cisa.cpp, and validation check queues.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces a complete reference implementation of a proposed soft fork enabling cross-input signature aggregation for witness version 2. Reaching a technical decision and ensuring consensus correctness for proposed soft forks is strategically important."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds companion implementations for cisa() descriptors, PSBT extension fields, and wallet signing in src/wallet/ and src/script/sign.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides experimental wallet signing and descriptor support for BIP460 transactions, solving user fee pain points for collaborative transactions. The wallet implementation remains deferrable while consensus is evaluated, and reviewers have already noted multiple open correctness issues in PSBT combining and signing completion."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
